# Toolbar omitted inner Row/Column alignment source fixtures

Three unchanged licensed originals at pinned AndroidX revision
`a095da93f8e98dea8748ceed79ea8427aade245f`; `sources.json` records exact URLs/SHA.

`inner-oracle.json.gz` contains 4,032 original default-policy factory/native
modifier tree results. It is deterministic gzip-compressed canonical UTF-8 JSON.
Shared modifier/coordinator originals remain under `../toolbar-row` and
`../toolbar-alignment` and are independently hash-verified and executed.

Reproduction, source call-site checks and exact host/scheduling/layer/atomic
sampling boundaries are documented in
`tools/androidx-toolbar-inner-alignment/README.md`.
